Banner.Description: Across 3+ years in industry and research, I build backend systems with Go/Python/Java, full-stack apps with Angular/React, and ML & LLM-powered applications — from data pipelines to RAG systems.
AboutMe.Title: About me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: With 3+ years of software development experience, I've worked as a full-stack developer using Angular/React for frontend and a backend engineer with Golang, Python, and Java for building scalable systems. I have worked extensively on REST APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization with Docker/Kubernetes to improve system efficiency, scalability, and maintainability.

I also have hands-on experience in machine learning and LLM applications — building predictive models, ETL/data pipelines, and retrieval-augmented (RAG) systems. As a Research Assistant at WPI, I currently work on probabilistic time-series forecasting (TimePre) and scalable computer-vision benchmarks (CV-Arena).
Some of the technologies that I have trained and worked on include :
Experience.Title: Experience

Experience.Jobs.Title: Research Assistant
Description: TimePre 2: Developed an ML framework for probabilistic forecasting with multi-hypothesis density estimation and a channel-based reversible normalization technique to mitigate distribution shifts and preserve long-horizon non-stationary patterns.

CV-Arena 2: Built the Pro-Edit dataset and a Resolution Baseline Agent, introducing a secure, scalable benchmark with a feedback-loop agentic architecture for collecting and curating high-fidelity image data.

Position Paper – Moral Auditing of LLM Agents: Proposed a framework for auditing RLHF-trained LLMs as non-neutral negotiation agents, designing a five-scenario bargaining and persuasion stress test that revealed a cooperative-assistant prior weakening under asymmetric pressure.

Experience.Jobs.Title: Software Development Engineer I
Description: In Dell-APEX day1 team, eliminated manual configuration overhead by building automated APIs (Python/Go/Java) for Azure HCI integration. Automated setup lifecycle for Windows servers — domain joining, security hardening, cluster config validation — reducing deployment timelines by 20%.

Streamlined initial server setup by creating a React/Angular/TypeScript UI for Day 1 operations with dynamic forms, validation flows, and data visualizations, reducing configuration errors and increasing efficiency by 15%.
Led a team of 4 building a Jenkins CI/CD pipeline for sanity testing dev images, reducing manual effort and boosting code quality by 30%.

Automated Day-1 infrastructure provisioning by developing containerized microservices (Docker/Kubernetes), integrating MongoDB and PostgreSQL APIs for configuration storage, validation, and retrieval, reducing service start failure rate by 25%.

Built Angular UI components for Day 1 & Day 2 operations teams to pre-config server settings (VLAN, authentication, backup), reducing manual setup steps and boosting configuration efficiency by 10%.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Agentic Advising Assistant
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description:
Architected a production-grade agentic advising platform using FastAPI, LangChain, and Google Gemini 2.5 Pro — orchestrating an Intent Classification Agent and a ReAct Adviser Agent over a Hybrid RAG pipeline (SQLite + ChromaDB) to automate complex academic advising workflows.
Built a multimodal PDF extraction pipeline via Gemini Vision API, optimized the ReAct loop with 7 specialized tools, real-time SSE streaming, and Redis session memory; containerized with Docker Compose, achieving ~10s avg latency and a projected 60% reduction in manual advising workload. Worcester, MA

Awarded 3rd Place at Harvard University Hackathon (EasyA x Flare Network x XRPL Commons). Harvard University Hackathon, Boston, MA

FeatureProjects.Projects.Description:

Engineered a normalized relational schema with interconnected tables; automated data generation using Python scripts and implemented backend data handling and query logic in Java to optimize retrieval performance and application responsiveness. Worcester Polytechnic Institute, Worcester, MA

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: American Sign Language Translation
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description:
Implemented Dense NNs, 2D Conv-RNNs, and DinoV2-enhanced models for spatiotemporal sign recognition. Extracted 3D pose/hand landmarks with MediaPipe; used augmentation (rotation, flipping, masking).
Achieved 48.7% Top-1 accuracy; improved semantic matching via similarity distribution visualizations. Worcester, MA
